body:
Maya (Sales): ACME POC is hitting 413 when they send the full chat history. Customer says payload is ~12MB. They pasted the raw curl response below.
Carlos (SE): 413 usually gateway/body limit. Can you paste the exact response + a sample request body (sanitized)?
Maya (Sales): Sure, pasted from their console:
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 12582912

{"messages": [{"role":"system","content":"..."}, {"role":"user","content":"long conversation... (omitted)"}], "max_tokens": 1024}

HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large
Server: envoy
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"request too large","code":"PayloadTooLarge"}
```
Jamal (Support): That log looks like the edge LB rejecting >10MB. Which deployment are they on? Hosted prod or Dedicated?
Maya (Sales): Hosted (us-west1).
Carlos (SE): Ok. Two failure modes to be clear: 1) HTTP 413 from gateway (size), 2) model-side truncation because of token window. This is 413 so gateway complaining first.
Liu (Platform Eng): We enforce a ~10MB ingress on the public API gateway for hosted to protect backend pods. If they need >10MB we usually recommend chunking, compression, or summarizing history.
Maya (Sales): Customer asking if we can just "increase the limit" for a short POC.
Priya (Eng Oncall): Short answer: for hosted public API we don't raise per-customer on prod gateway without infra change. For Dedicated we can adjust. I'll open a ticket to validate if we can temporarily route via a bypass ingress, but there are security/ops approvals.
Jamal (Support): In the meantime, quick workarounds that have worked:
- Send only the last N messages (3-6) and a generated summary of prior history
- Store long history externally (S3) and send a pointer + retrieval step
- Use chunked approach: split conversation into chunks, call the model iteratively and stitch results
Carlos (SE): For summarization we share a small helper: build a condensed system message using the first 20 messages -> call a summarization endpoint -> prepend summary to the last messages. That usually cuts payload to <1MB. Example pseudocode: 
```bash
# pseudo: summarize old history then call generation
summarized = curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/summarize -d '{"messages": [...old history...] }'
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"messages": [{"role":"system","content":"summary: '"$summarized"'"}, ...last_messages] }'
```
Maya (Sales): They said they can't lose fidelity for now, they want to send full transcript.
Liu (Platform Eng): If the customer is open to Dedicated/reserved capacity we can increase ingress to 50MB or more as part of the deployment config. That requires a support ticket and provisioning lead time (2-5 business days) and a billing change.
Carlos (SE): Also note model token windows: even if we get the HTTP payload through, the model may only accept N tokens (e.g., 32k tokens). If the transcript maps to more tokens than the model supports we'll still need summarization/rolling context or use a longer-context model variant if available.
Maya (Sales): Can you confirm estimated cost/billing for bumping ingress for a POC? Customer asked for pricing vs doing engineering changes.
Liu (Platform Eng): For Dedicated we typically bill extra provisioning and network egress; rough quick quote: add-on for high-ingress POC ~ $1k/day for dedicated infra depending on size. Need sales ops to finalize.
Priya (Eng Oncall): I've created INF-4321 to evaluate temporary routing and to collect gateway logs and approvals. Jamal, can you attach the customer's full request sample to the ticket?
Jamal (Support): Done — attached sanitized payload and the gateway log showing: 
```
[2026-10-12T16:12:34Z] client=3.112.45.21 request_len=12582912 limit=10485760 result=413
```
Priya (Eng Oncall): Thanks. I'll update by EOD with feasibility and any short-term bypass. If we can't, recommend the summarization + chunking pattern until Dedicated is provisioned.
Maya (Sales): Thanks all — I'll loop back to the customer with three options (1‑summarize/trim, 2‑chunk & stitch, 3‑Dedicated bump) and link INF-4321.
deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4321 created by Priya (Eng Oncall)
